_comments: Runs a submitted response's on-submit automations. The handler registers under HandlerKey
'Forms.RunAutomations' (BaseWorkHandler, forms-core-entities-server) on hosts of type MJWorker;
a host opts in through workQueue.subscriptions in its mj.config.cjs.
Delivery is at-least-once: retries back off with jitter between BackoffBaseSeconds and
BackoffMaxSeconds and dead-letter after MaxAttempts, so the handler must be idempotent. It
is, in the handler rather than in the schema: a (FormAutomationID, FormResponseID) pair is
NOT unique by design (an OnPartial step writes one run row per partial save), so a
redelivery skips a step already Succeeded for the submission it was enqueued for instead of
relying on an index. PartitionMode None: no ordering is promised between responses.

fields.Name: forms.run-automations
fields.Description: MJ Forms: runs the on-submit automations of each submitted response (HandlerKey Forms.RunAutomations).
